cmd: PAT=$(grep GITHUB_PAT /mnt/agents/output/.env | cut -d= -f2) && curl -s -H "Authorization: token $PAT" "https://api.github.com/repos/toxicwind/effusion-labs/actions/runs?per_page=3" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f"{r['name']} | {r['status']} | {r['conclusion'] or 'N/A'} | {r['head_sha'][:8]}") for r in d.get('workflow_runs', [])[:3]]"
